name: G-Cup Kyonyuu Gear Dizzy X [Zekusu]
original_name: Gカップ巨乳ギア ディズィー X[ゼクス]
source: This work allows you to enjoy playing with Dizzy from the "Guilty Gear X" era. As the story progresses from "Guilty Gear X" to "Guilty Gear XX," Dizzy regains her original gentle and somewhat naive personality due to changes in her environment. Here it depicts her as a lonely and somewhat misanthropic character before regaining her true personality. Of course, the circle's policy that "the closest male to a female fighting game character is the player themselves" remains unchanged, and you can enjoy a slightly different play experience compared to the previous series.
